raw_record.question_text: One slice of a circular cake is $15\%$ of the whole cake. What is the size of the angle marked with the question mark?

method.method_draft: First read the image: it shows a circular cake with one sector-shaped slice removed/pulled out, and the question mark labels the angle of that slice at its pointed/central end. Read the text: this one slice is 15% of the whole circular cake. Use the rule that a full circle is 360 degrees and a sector's central angle is the same fraction of 360 degrees as the sector is of the whole circle. Compute 15% of 360 degrees to get the marked angle.

method.method_draft: First read the image: the separated piece is a sector of the same circular cake, and the question mark marks the sector angle between its two radial sides. Read the text: the area of this sector is 15% of the total cake area. Let the unknown angle be theta. Use the sector area formula: sector area = (theta/360) times the area of the full circle. Since the sector area divided by the circle area is 0.15, solve theta/360 = 0.15, giving theta = 54 degrees.
